name: Nautobot
description: Network source of truth and automation platform for documenting infrastructure and driving workflows.

envVars.description: Allowed hostnames for the web UI

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      NAUTOBOT_DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      NAUTOBOT_DB_NAME: nautobot
      NAUTOBOT_DB_USER: nautobot
      NAUTOBOT_DB_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      NAUTOBOT_REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      NAUTOBOT_SECRET_KEY: {{env.NAUTOBOT_SECRET_KEY}}
      NAUTOBOT_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD: {{env.NAUTOBOT_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD}}
      NAUTOBOT_SUPERUSER_API_TOKEN: {{env.NAUTOBOT_SUPERUSER_API_TOKEN}}
      NAUTOBOT_ALLOWED_HOSTS: {{env.NAUTOBOT_ALLOWED_HOSTS}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/media:/opt/nautobot/media
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: nautobot
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: nautobot
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
